component.name: INAA
component.summary: GTK4/Wayland-native media player inspired by IINA

description.p: INAA is a GTK4 media player for Linux, built on libmpv and rendered natively through the OpenGL render API (works under Wayland and X11, not just XWayland). It's inspired by IINA's design on macOS.

INAA adalah pemutar media GTK4 untuk Linux, dibangun di atas libmpv dan dirender langsung lewat OpenGL render API (jalan native di Wayland maupun X11, bukan cuma lewat XWayland). Terinspirasi dari desain IINA di macOS.

ul.li: Native Wayland rendering (no X11/XWayland embedding trick)
Dual/overlapping subtitle tracks with per-track styling
Video crop, hardware decoding, A-B loop, chapter navigation
Mini-player mode, drag-and-drop playlist, resume playback

description.p: First Flatpak packaging pass. See the project README for the full changelog.
